goal: Protect blocks needed for wallet rescans or external indexers from being deleted on pruned nodes
Allow users and external software to keep blocks temporarily without turning off node pruning
agreement: Broad concept support for letting external wallets and indexers operate on pruned nodes
Verified by testing an external indexer on a pruned signet node (optout21)
Support because it protects blocks needed for wallet rescanning when unloaded (achow101)
Prior objections on API extensibility and startup race conditions were resolved (luke-jr, shuv-amp)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fills a clear functional gap for external wallets and indexers on pruned nodes
Downstream integrations can safely prevent block deletion and avoid rescan race conditions
